document.reading: Contemporary Persian. Commas/semicolon delimit the nominal image and two apposed adjectives in حشره؛ ریز، پرکار. Full حشره is normally hash/re; ریز is one syllable; پرکار por/kar. No nonce stem, swallowed ezafe, imported species or author-only pronunciation. This is an author linguistic judgment, not empirical pronunciation evidence or independent/native acceptance.
document.meaning: An insect; tiny, industrious. The elliptical tableau retains all three source concepts in ordinary words. Product26 still contrasts work with priorities/leisure; the source feedback can still ask whether WE are the bugs.
document.preserved: All nine stable choices and evaluation strings remain paired; controls/selection logic/three named outcomes and24 mixed outcomes unchanged.

documents.rationale: Transparent insect plus tiny and busy descriptors in a compact poetic tableau. Normal hash/re/riz/por/kar five syllables; punctuation marks apposition, no invented stem or species.

originalFinding.rationale: The delivered حشرکِ پرکار does not naturally and transparently express little bug: it requires reconstructing an unusually shortened stem from حشره and adopting the author-only /hashrak/ pronunciation. The exact ordinary text contains no pronunciation guidance. Under the existing literary authority, natural target wording is required as well as actual meter, so a private stipulated scan is insufficient for independent acceptance. This is an editorial lexical-clarity finding, not a claim that every possible reading has six syllables or that coined words are categorically forbidden. Rework the full line into naturally intelligible insect/smallness/busyness wording and independently scan it with its surrounding poems; retain no invented ant/bee species. Update this display choice and managed resolver index22 together and recheck products18–26.
